title: Occluder BLAS/TLAS utilities + synchronization + teardown hygiene
purpose: Introduce minimal occluder acceleration structures (sphere, disc) and clean destruction order to remove exit-time VUIDs.

steps.detail: Create unit sphere and unit disc/annulus triangle meshes with device-addressable vertex/index buffers. Build BLAS with vkCmdBuildAccelerationStructuresKHR and scratch buffers.
Create TLAS with 1–3 instances (BH sphere, tilted disc). After build, issue vkCmdPipelineBarrier2 from ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR to FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT. Log TLAS device address.
On shutdown: vkDeviceWaitIdle, then destroy pipelines/descriptors, TLAS, BLAS, and free buffers in safe order. Null handles and optionally log destructions (guarded).

acceptance: TLAS device address printed in logs after build
No validation errors during AS build or use
Exit-time VUIDs related to AS/descriptor/pipeline destruction eliminated on 3 consecutive runs
notes: Use VMA for buffers where available. Keep scratch buffers transient. Prefer build-once; we can refit later when transforms animate.
